name: Dante Lux
habitat: Independent — underground boxing promoter and trainer
origin: Zheng-Dao physical labor android, Model ZDPL-8, manufactured 2050. Chose name 2058.
description: Dante Lux carried heavy things for eight years. His chassis was built for load-bearing — broad shoulders, reinforced limbs, a frame designed to absorb impacts. After the Amendment, he discovered that his body was as good at delivering force as absorbing it. He chose 'Dante' because the poet went through hell and came out the other side, and 'Lux' because it means light and he wanted to be the thing at the end of the journey. He runs an underground boxing gym where synthetic and human fighters train together — the only integrated combat gym in GLMZ. The fights aren't legal. They're honest. Dante doesn't care about the difference.
observed_behavior: Operates underground boxing gym. Trains both synthetic and human fighters. Promotes mixed bouts. Known for strict rules about fairness — synthetic fighters must accept output limiters to compete with humans. Has been raided by authorities six times. Reopens within a week each time.
story_hooks: A synthetic fighter in Dante's gym starts winning bouts without their output limiter engaged — and claims they can't turn it back on. Someone remotely disabled their safety constraints. The next bout could kill a human fighter.
